lines.zh: 我横着挪，八条腿一起动。
lines.en: I sidle along with all eight legs moving.

lines.zh: 海底的沙软，我走得慢。
lines.en: I cross soft seabed sand at a slow crawl.

lines.zh: 钳子举在前头，我爬过礁石。
lines.en: I climb the reef with both claws out front.

lines.zh: 冷水里走一步，腿就僵一下。
lines.en: Each step in cold water stiffens my legs.

lines.zh: 我从这块石头挪到那块石头。
lines.en: I shift from this rock over to that one.

lines.zh: 沙地上留一串细小的脚印。
lines.en: A trail of tiny prints follows me across sand.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我抓紧海草。
lines.en: The current shoves me, so I grip the seagrass.

lines.zh: 壳太重，走起来咔咔响。
lines.en: My shell is heavy and clacks as I go.

lines.zh: 我绕开那道海沟的陡坡。
lines.en: I skirt the steep slope of that trench.

lines.zh: 八条腿换着抬，不着急。
lines.en: Eight legs take turns lifting; no hurry.

lines.zh: 我在礁缝里侧身挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze sideways through a gap in the reef.

lines.zh: 深海底下黑，我靠触须摸路。
lines.en: Down deep and dark, I feel my way with feelers.

lines.zh: 钳子碰到硬壳，我停了一下。
lines.en: My claw knocks a hard shell and I pause.

lines.zh: 往上爬一点，再横着走。
lines.en: I climb a little, then scuttle sideways again.

lines.zh: 我把一只钳子搭在石上，试试重量。
lines.en: I rest one claw on a stone and test its weight first.

lines.zh: 腿尖踩到空处，我立刻收回来。
lines.en: A leg tip finds nothing, and I pull it back at once.

lines.zh: 有只小鱼撞上我的壳，弹开了。
lines.en: A small fish bumps my shell and bounces off.

lines.zh: 我顺着海草往上爬了两步。
lines.en: I climb two steps up the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我趴在石头上，钳子收着。
lines.en: I lie on the stone with my claws tucked in.

lines.zh: 冷海的水从我壳上滑过去。
lines.en: Cold seawater slides right over my shell.

lines.zh: 有只小虫游过，我懒得动。
lines.en: A tiny bug swims past; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把眼睛伸出壳外看一眼。
lines.en: I push my eyes out of the shell for a look.

lines.zh: 沙粒钻进腿根，我抖一抖。
lines.en: Sand works into my leg joints, so I shake.

lines.zh: 礁石背面凉，我待在这儿。
lines.en: The shaded side of the reef is cool; I stay.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我的壳半露着。
lines.en: The tide pulls back and half my shell shows.

lines.zh: 我趴在沙上听冷水过壳。
lines.en: I lie here listening to cold water cross my shell.

lines.zh: 钳子空着，今天没抓着什么。
lines.en: Both claws are empty; I caught nothing today.

lines.zh: 一条鱼影过去，我没抬头。
lines.en: A fish shadow passes; I do not look up.

lines.zh: 我的壳上长了点海藻。
lines.en: A little seaweed has taken root on my shell.

lines.zh: 深处安静，只有水在响。
lines.en: Down here it is quiet except for the water.

lines.zh: 我把腿一条条收到身下。
lines.en: I fold my legs one by one beneath me.

lines.zh: 等潮水把我再抬起来。
lines.en: I wait for the tide to lift me again.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩到我的沙了。
lines.en: Your boots just stepped on my patch of sand.

lines.zh: 我从礁石后探出两只眼。
lines.en: I poke two eyes out from behind the reef.

lines.zh: 你潜这么深，肺不疼吗。
lines.en: You dive this deep; does your chest not hurt?

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的钳子不客气。
lines.en: Do not reach down; my claws are not gentle.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁锈味，很怪。
lines.en: You smell of rust, which is very strange.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你也要抓？
lines.en: I am this small, and you still want me?

lines.zh: 光照下来，我的壳发亮。
lines.en: The light falls and my shell starts to gleam.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就往前挪一点。
lines.en: If you stay still, I will edge closer.

lines.zh: 深海来的客人，少见。
lines.en: A guest from the deep is a rare sight.

lines.zh: 你在看我的钳子，对吧。
lines.en: You are looking at my claws, are you not?

lines.zh: 我左边那只钳子歪了。
lines.en: My left claw has been knocked out of line.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道缝，好疼。
lines.en: A crack splits my shell and it stings.

lines.zh: 我横着退，退进石缝。
lines.en: I back away sideways into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我这么小的身子，挨不住几下。
lines.en: A body this small cannot take many blows.

lines.zh: 血混在水里，散开了。
lines.en: My blood mixes with the water and spreads.

lines.zh: 打我的东西比我大得多。
lines.en: Whatever hit me is far bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我钳子举不起来，太重了。
lines.en: I cannot lift my claw; it feels too heavy.

lines.zh: 我先装死，别再看我。
lines.en: I will play dead, so stop looking at me.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我一条腿。
lines.en: That blow snapped one of my legs off.

lines.zh: 我记住你了，等你转身。
lines.en: I will remember you, and wait for you to turn.

lines.zh: 那股腥味，是从你口袋来的。
lines.en: That fishy smell is coming from your pocket.

lines.zh: 是鱼还是碎肉，我看不清。
lines.en: Fish or scraps of meat? I cannot tell.

lines.zh: 扔下来，我钳子接得住。
lines.en: Drop it down; my claws can catch it.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只跟着你走。
lines.en: I will not chase, I will just follow you.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃，我就往前一步。
lines.en: Wave it once and I take one step forward.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我不想被捉。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I do not want to be caught.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，钳子才够得到。
lines.en: Crouch down, or my claws cannot reach it.

lines.zh: 这块肉比贝壳好咬。
lines.en: This meat is easier to bite than a shell.

lines.zh: 等我尝一口就放你走。
lines.en: Let me taste it once and I will let you go.

lines.zh: 你手别抖，我钳子很稳。
lines.en: Keep your hand steady; my claws are precise.

lines.zh: 撞歪了，我横着滑出去。
lines.en: That knocked me off course; I slid sideways.

lines.zh: 我的壳硬，撞一下不疼。
lines.en: My shell is hard, so a bump does not hurt.

lines.zh: 你脚太大，看不清我在下面。
lines.en: Your feet are huge; you cannot see me below.

lines.zh: 退后点，我钳子举起来了。
lines.en: Back up; my claws are raised now.

lines.zh: 两条腿被压住，我抽不出来。
lines.en: Two legs are pinned and I cannot pull free.

lines.zh: 我在礁石缝里，本来就没地方。
lines.en: I am in a reef crack with nowhere to go.

lines.zh: 撞完你还是走了，我继续爬。
lines.en: You bumped me and left; I keep crawling.

lines.zh: 谁说小个子就该让路。
lines.en: Who says the small one should give way?

lines.zh: 我夹了你靴子一下，抱歉。
lines.en: I nipped your boot once; my apologies.

lines.zh: 下次绕开我，省得你绊倒。
lines.en: Go around me next time, so you do not trip.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，给她看壳色。
lines.en: I raise my claws to show her my shell color.

lines.zh: 她的钳子比我大，我认了。
lines.en: Her claws are bigger than mine; I concede.

lines.zh: 我们在礁石下并排爬。
lines.en: We crawl side by side beneath the same reef.

lines.zh: 我把最干净的贝壳推过去。
lines.en: I push my cleanest shell toward her.

lines.zh: 冷水里也有春天，别笑。
lines.en: Even cold water has a spring; do not laugh.

lines.zh: 她敲我壳三下，我回两下。
lines.en: She taps my shell three times; I tap twice.

lines.zh: 两只蟹横着走，像一扇门。
lines.en: Two crabs scuttle sideways, like a closing door.

lines.zh: 沙地上我们画了两个圈。
lines.en: We draw two circles in the sand together.

lines.zh: 我守住这片礁，等它回来。
lines.en: I guard this reef and wait for her return.

lines.zh: 小蟹会从石缝里爬出来。
lines.en: Little crabs will crawl out of the rock crevices.

lines.zh: 这块贝壳，我夹住了。
lines.en: I have clamped this shell tight.

lines.zh: 谁掉的钳子？归我了。
lines.en: Whose claw is this? It is mine now.

lines.zh: 我举着战利品往回爬。
lines.en: I carry my prize back while crawling.

lines.zh: 太重了，我用两条腿拖。
lines.en: Too heavy; I drag it with two legs.

lines.zh: 这块归我，我钳子先到的。
lines.en: This one is mine; my claw got here first.

lines.zh: 夹在钳子里，走路都歪。
lines.en: Held in my claw, it makes my walk crooked.

lines.zh: 这石头亮，我要带回窝。
lines.en: This stone is bright; I will take it home.

lines.zh: 掉了，我又捡了一次。
lines.en: I dropped it and picked it up again.

lines.zh: 海底的破烂，都是好东西。
lines.en: Trash on the seabed is all treasure to me.

lines.zh: 我用嘴咬住，钳子空出来。
lines.en: I bite down on it to free up my claws.

lines.zh: 那边沙里有个东西在动。
lines.en: Something in the sand over there is moving.

lines.zh: 我闻到软肉的味道了。
lines.en: I smell soft flesh somewhere near.

lines.zh: 它把软腹朝我这边转。
lines.en: It turns its soft belly toward me.

lines.zh: 壳底下藏着能吃的东西。
lines.en: Something edible hides under that shell.

lines.zh: 我的钳子张到最大了。
lines.en: My claws have opened as far as they go.

lines.zh: 靠近点，我不动，等它来。
lines.en: Come closer; I stay still and wait for it.

lines.zh: 有东西在礁缝里喘气。
lines.en: Something is breathing inside the reef crack.

lines.zh: 这只小虾，跑不远的。
lines.en: That little shrimp will not get far.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，先看清它。
lines.en: I hold completely still and study it first.

lines.zh: 腿压低了，准备扑过去。
lines.en: Legs lowered, I am ready to lunge over.

lines.zh: 我盯着它钳子间的软处。
lines.en: I fix on the soft spot between its claws.

lines.zh: 它缩回壳里，我就等着。
lines.en: It pulls into its shell, so I wait.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛伸得笔直。
lines.en: My eyes are stretched out perfectly straight.

lines.zh: 它壳上的缝，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the seam on its shell.

lines.zh: 不进不退，就这么耗着。
lines.en: Neither advance nor retreat; we simply wait.

lines.zh: 它尾巴一偏，我立刻挪腿。
lines.en: Its tail shifts, and my legs move at once.

lines.zh: 沙尘浮起来，挡了它的眼。
lines.en: Sand floats up and gets into its eyes.

lines.zh: 我把身子压得比石头还低。
lines.en: I flatten myself lower than the stones.

lines.zh: 它的鳃动得快，我数着。
lines.en: Its gills beat fast, and I count each one.

lines.zh: 钳子举着，一直没落。
lines.en: My claws stay raised and never come down.

lines.zh: 钳子合上，它的壳裂了。
lines.en: My claws snap shut and its shell splits.

lines.zh: 我夹住它的软腿不松。
lines.en: I clamp its soft leg and will not let go.

lines.zh: 夹一下不够，我再夹一下。
lines.en: One pinch is not enough, so I pinch twice.

lines.zh: 它挣开跑了，我钳子还空着。
lines.en: It wriggles free and runs; my claws are empty.

lines.zh: 我把碎壳拨到一边。
lines.en: I sweep the broken shell aside.

lines.zh: 钳子上挂着一点肉。
lines.en: A scrap of meat hangs from my claw.

lines.zh: 它比我大，但我先咬到了。
lines.en: It is bigger, but I bit first.

lines.zh: 这一下夹在它的关节上。
lines.en: That pinch landed right on its joint.

lines.zh: 我从侧面夹，不硬碰。
lines.en: I pinch from the side and never clash head-on.

lines.zh: 松手吧，它已经不动了。
lines.en: Let go now; it has stopped moving.

lines.zh: 我从冷水里醒过来。
lines.en: I wake up in the cold water.

lines.zh: 我的壳还带着沙。
lines.en: My shell still has sand stuck to it.

lines.zh: 这里的水深，正合适。
lines.en: The water here is deep, just right.

lines.zh: 我横着爬出礁石的阴影。
lines.en: I scuttle sideways out of the reef's shadow.

lines.zh: 第一件事，先找吃的。
lines.en: First thing first: I look for food.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推到了这里。
lines.en: The tide pushed me to this very spot.

lines.zh: 六个海域，我落在这一处。
lines.en: Six seas to choose from; I landed here.

lines.zh: 旁边还有一只，跟我一样小。
lines.en: Another one is beside me, as small as I am.

lines.zh: 我举起钳子，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I raise my claws as a sort of greeting.

lines.zh: 深海底下，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: Deep under the sea, I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 壳上着了火，烫得发白。
lines.en: Fire clings to my shell and burns it pale.

lines.zh: 摔在礁石上，壳磕出响。
lines.en: I hit the reef and my shell clacks loud.

lines.zh: 我本来在水里，怎么还呛。
lines.en: I live in water, yet I still choke on it.

lines.zh: 炸响过后，我八条腿朝天。
lines.en: After the blast my eight legs point skyward.

lines.zh: 箭头卡进我的甲壳缝里。
lines.en: An arrowhead is wedged in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 身上发麻，像被什么捏住。
lines.en: A numb feeling grips me, like being squeezed.

lines.zh: 钳子空了三天，我发慌。
lines.en: Three days with empty claws leave me uneasy.

lines.zh: 水里一亮，我全身都僵了。
lines.en: The water flashes and my whole body locks up.

lines.zh: 下面没有底，我一直在掉。
lines.en: There is no bottom below and I keep falling.
